jobs.title: Director -  Product Management (Payments/Fintech)
jobs.description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes

Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY.

Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com

What skills and experiences do I need?

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, including presenting to customers and senior executives

- Excellent problem-solving skills, and ability to come up recommendations using data

- Good interpersonal skills, ability to work in teams with a results-oriented attitude

- Can deal with ambiguity and break complex and vaguely defined problems into a clear and actionable set of steps

- Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams

- The ability to think big , but at the same time break things down into smaller components, and build high-level roadmaps from that.

- A clear sense of ownership and accountability.

- Obsess over building a clear, calm and beautiful product by collaborating with designers, developers and business leaders across the company.

- Must have a good understanding of mobile, web and cloud technology space

- Has 12+ years of work experience in a Product Manager role.  Atleast 7+ years experience in Fintech Space

- Should have experience working with Payment Processes

Why Zenoti?

- Be part of an innovative company that is revolutionizing the wellness and beauty industry.

- Work with a dynamic and diverse team that values collaboration, creativity, and growth.

- Opportunity to lead impactful projects and help shape the global success of Zenoti’s platform.

- Attractive compensation.

- Medical coverage for yourself and your immediate family.

- Access to regular yoga, meditation, breathwork, and stress management sessions. We also include your family in benefit awareness initiatives.

- Regular social activities, and opportunities to give back through social work and community initiatives.

Senior Manager Product Management - HyperConnect

AI-Powered Customer Engagement Platform

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India

About Zenoti

Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our AI-powered platform transforms every guest touchpoint into new revenue, helping businesses grow twice as fast as industry peers. We power more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas, and fitness studios in over 50 countries, including global brands such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, and TONI&GUY. Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation and recognition as a Great Place to Work.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager to own and drive the product strategy for  HyperConnect , Zenoti's intelligent customer engagement platform. HyperConnect is a cornerstone of our AI Workforce suite, leveraging large language models and conversational AI to revolutionize how wellness businesses engage with their customers across every channel.

HyperConnect (also known as AI Concierge) is our intelligent engagement hub that analyzes every customer interaction across phone, SMS, and web—identifying missed revenue opportunities and building brand loyalty. It helps teams stay on top of clients who abandon appointments or inquiries, capturing every possible sale and elevating the guest experience. No more lost touchpoints—just continuous, connected engagement.

Key Responsibilities

- Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for HyperConnect, ensuring alignment with Zenoti's broader AI Workforce strategy

- Partner with AI/ML engineering teams to translate LLM capabilities into customer-facing features that solve real business problems for wellness industry operators

- Gather requirements from existing and potential customers, write functional requirements documents, and build agile product backlogs for AI-powered engagement features

- Work closely with data science teams to define conversational AI behaviors, prompt engineering strategies, and model fine-tuning requirements

- Drive cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, sales, and customer success to deliver exceptional AI products that drive measurable business outcomes

- Define success metrics and KPIs for HyperConnect performance, including engagement rates, revenue recovery, customer retention, and satisfaction scores

- Stay current with advancements in LLMs, generative AI, and conversational AI technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance product capabilities

- Manage stakeholder expectations and build buy-in for AI product investments across the organization

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Technical Product Manager, with at least 1 year working on AI/ML-powered products

- Demonstrated experience shipping products that leverage large language models (LLMs), conversational AI, or multi-channel engagement platforms

- Strong understanding of generative AI concepts including prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and evaluation metrics

- Technical or engineering background with the ability to have deep technical discussions with AI/ML engineers

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to present AI product strategies to customers and senior executives

- Experience gathering requirements and translating complex AI capabilities into clear, actionable product specifications

- Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive results in a fast-paced environment

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to drive product decisions and measure AI product performance

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with omni-channel customer engagement platforms (phone, SMS, web, chat)

- Background in B2B SaaS products, particularly in the beauty, wellness, or hospitality industries

- Experience with NLP/NLU platforms and customer interaction analytics

- MBA from a premier management institute or equivalent experience

- Understanding of the wellness industry and its unique operational challenges

AI-Specific Competencies

- LLM Product Intuition: Ability to understand what LLMs can and cannot do, and translate that into practical product features

- Conversational Design: Experience defining conversation flows, handling edge cases, and creating natural dialogue experiences across multiple channels

- AI Ethics & Safety: Understanding of responsible AI practices, including bias mitigation, privacy considerations, and appropriate AI guardrails

- Prompt Engineering: Familiarity with prompt design patterns and strategies to optimize model outputs for specific use cases

- AI Evaluation: Experience defining metrics and evaluation frameworks to measure AI product quality and performance

Why Zenoti?

- Be at the forefront of AI innovation in the wellness industry, building products that directly impact 30,000+ businesses globally

- Work with cutting-edge AI/ML technologies and shape the future of how businesses engage with their customers

- Join a dynamic and diverse team that values collaboration, creativity, and growth

- Competitive compensation with attractive benefits including medical coverage for you and your family

- Access to regular yoga, meditation, breathwork, and stress management sessions—we practice what we preach!

- Opportunity to lead impactful AI products at a $1B+ unicorn company
